title: Sentetik Tabular Veri Üretimi ve Değerlendirme Projesi
summary: A Turkish-language research project that generates and evaluates synthetic versions of the UCI Adult and Bank Marketing tabular datasets to address class imbalance, comparing GAN/VAE deep generative models against SMOTE-family resampling and visualizing results in a Streamlit dashboard. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata) as the core synthetic-data generators, alongside sdmetrics-based similarity metrics.
needs: CopulaGAN key actually instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, not sdv's CopulaGANSynthesizer class -- naming may be misleading in source.
